text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1555
FURTHER AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 742 AS AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL
DECREE NO. 773 TRANSFERRING THE REGIONAL CENTER OF REGION IX FROM JOLO TO
ZAMBOANGA CITY
WHEREAS, it is policy of the State to institute changes in existing administrative structure of government
according to the changing requirements of the country;
WHEREAS, present political and socio-economic conditions in Region IX point to the need for change in the
administrative structure of the area to improve government and private operations;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby further amend Presidential Decree No. 742 as amended by
Presidential Decree No. 773 as follows:
"1. Region IX shall be composed of the Province of Basilan, Sulu, Tawi-Tawi, Zamboanga del Norte and
Zamboanga del Sur, and the cities of Dapitan, Dipolog, Pagadian and Zamboanga, with the last as Region
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
